response.why: Developing a land is clearly better than passing with a land drop unused. Between playing Island or Swamp, both let me flash in Floodpits Drowner if needed since Darkslick Shores covers the other color, so land choice is roughly even. But their board is just a 1/1 Spyglass Siren - stunning it now spends my best flash tempo card on a minor target and taps out my whole turn. Better to develop the land and hold Floodpits Drowner up for a bigger threat (or to ambush an attacker) rather than cash it in now.
response.plan: Play a land each turn, hold Floodpits Drowner as an instant-speed answer for a bigger threat rather than using it on their 1/1 Siren, and curve into Preacher of the Schism next turn once I have 3 lands.

response.why: Playing my land drop first is strictly better than casting Preacher without it - I lose nothing by developing to 4 lands, and I'll still get to cast Preacher of the Schism (or hold up Enduring Curiosity as a flash blocker/ambush) with the resulting mana. Between Island and Swamp, Swamp adds a bit more black redundancy for my Preachers/Sheoldred, though Darkslick already covers both colors so it's close either way.
response.plan: Play a land to reach 4 mana this turn, then cast Preacher of the Schism to rebuild my board (or hold up Enduring Curiosity at instant speed if a bigger threat appears). Get Sheoldred down next turn once I hit BB availability with extra mana to spare.

response.why: I have exactly 4 mana with double black available - this is the turn to deploy Sheoldred, the Apocalypse. It's my best card: a 4/5 deathtouch body that immediately swings the life race (opponent already down to 18 from the draw trigger) and generates ongoing value every turn. Their board is just a tapped 1/1, so there's no reason to hold up Enduring Curiosity defensively instead of proactively landing my bomb.
response.plan: Cast Sheoldred, the Apocalypse now while I have exactly the mana for it. It out-classes anything they can do at 4 mana and starts draining their life total immediately. Hold Preacher of the Schism and Enduring Curiosity for future turns.

response.plan: Attack with Sheoldred (deathtouch punishes any block), keep Preacher and Deep-Cavern Bat back since they're summoning sick, and hold Enduring Curiosity for a flash blocker on the crackback.
